historical_record.description: Excelsior Playground, Russia and Madrid Streets, was dedicated, according to the official list of 1947 recreation bond playgrounds the Recreation and Park Commission entered in its minutes.

The Recreation and Park Commission approved a $6,000 agreement with Richard Schadt Associates, landscape architects, to design a play structure and site improvements for Excelsior Playground at Russia Avenue and Madrid Street.
